title: Kimi K3.1 Pro (Cerebras, Trial Run)
notes: Bring-up trial run on omp, used to shake out harness, profiler and held-out-route bugs; the environment changed mid-run. Its best valid checkpoint (4b54858, 15.7 h) scores 1.695x on all 25 routes, level with the Kaze master reference (1.693x) on the same routes, and passes the PLAY=1 runtime smoke. Its final commit (d6af2f6) reached 1.79x but failed the video gate on 7 of 19 private routes because of a one-line typo in a 4-vertex shadow lookup table (253312a). The run ended when Cerebras withdrew the trial model.
